_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: no confirmed breaker, so the skilled call is hold the Complacency rung until F&G/momentum/funding expands or breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative descriptive only (inflow print) with no phase call — agree on cautionary tone, not on a directional leg
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 47-54, 30d momentum low-single-digit drift, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with F&G under 40 and funding negative (to Anxiety) or composite through 62 with expanding momentum/funding (to Disbelief)
